text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first. It tests the latest routing paths and prompt versions against real-world inputs, catching edge cases the oldest PR won’t expose. name: Gauge
text: PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR risks exposing *new* edge cases that don’t reflect stable behavior—meaning we could waste time debugging transient issues instead of validating against proven routing. Settle it by comparing the two runs—if the oldest PR’s shadow mode catches more actionable issues, it wins.

name: Overhaul
